question_text: A municipal planning officer, Mr. Reyes, was found to have accepted a ₱50,000 cash gift from a contractor in exchange for expediting a building permit. The Ombudsman filed administrative charges against him. Which of the following statements best describes the possible liabilities of Mr. Reyes under RA 6713?

options.text: He may face only administrative liability, such as suspension or removal, but not criminal liability because RA 6713 only imposes administrative penalties.
He may face both administrative and criminal liabilities, as the same act can give rise to separate proceedings under the Code of Conduct.
He may face only criminal liability if the act also violates the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, but administrative liability is waived.
He may face neither administrative nor criminal liability if he returns the gift before the complaint is filed.
